description: This file defines interfaces related to eviction strategies and purge observables for a pooled queue cache in Orleans streaming infrastructure.

classes.name: IEvictionStrategy
classes.description: Interface for eviction strategies used by the pooled queue cache, including properties for purge observable and methods for performing purge and block allocation.

classes.name: IPurgeObservable
classes.description: Interface providing purge-related actions such as removing oldest message, and properties to access newest, oldest messages, item count, and emptiness status.

methods.name: PerformPurge
methods.description: Method to trigger purge operation at a given UTC time.

methods.name: OnBlockAllocated
methods.description: Method called when a new block is allocated by the data adapter.

methods.name: RemoveOldestMessage
methods.description: Removes the oldest message from the cache.
